meta.title: TAN Verification: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Invoke TAN Verification via API and observe the authorization result for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
Repeat TAN Verification as an MDM / Master Data Team user and compare availability or authorization
Verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
Sign in as the two differently authorized users in the same tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Invoke TAN Verification via API and observe the authorization result for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role; Repeat TAN Verification as an MDM / Master Data Team user and compare availability or authorization; Verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan; Sign in as the two differently authorized users in the same tenant

args.need: sign in to the Enterprise tenant as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role, invoke TAN Verification via API and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as an MDM / Master Data Team user and compare the result

steps.note: The required role-specific sessions and TAN Verification API action are not available in the catalog.
Confirm the session remains free of crashes or raw application errors after the tester completes the unavailable role comparison.
